verdict.rationale: Airbyte exposes a full API, Terraform provider, and PyAirbyte SDK that let an AI-native user programmatically manage many connections/syncs/connectors as code rather than clicking through a UI one at a time, and the API is confirmed live and auth-gated at runtime. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk/batch endpoint (e.g., bulk-create or bulk-trigger for many connections simultaneously) — automation is implied via looping API/Terraform calls rather than a first-class bulk operation feature. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API operations, documented multi-item bulk actions in the UI, and independent hands-on evidence of managing many items at once.
